name: Riesgos Chile
description: Chile's natural hazards as one-click layers: recent earthquakes (USGS), wildfire hotspots of the last days (NASA FIRMS, VIIRS), and SENAPRED's tsunami, volcanic and wildfire hazard maps: areas to evacuate, evacuation routes, meeting points, the 30 m contour, volcanic hazard areas and fire recurrence. For information and planning; in an emergency, follow SENAPRED's instructions.
author: Daniel Díaz
